why: Each read shape reports what its calls filtered on: `filtered_on` has one entry per combination of equality fields (`equal`, sorted) and bounded field (`range`, absent when the call bounded nothing), with the number of calls, in code point order. Four range reads over `at` also fixed `station` and one did not; four aggregates - over the whole table, over a time range, and over a time range fixing `station` or `temperature` - are one shape with four entries, sorted by the equality fields' contents and then by the bounded field rather than in the order they were recorded; a full scan that filtered on nothing says so with an empty `equal`. Names only, never a value. A write takes no filter and has no `filtered_on` at all - absent, not empty, because it was never asked.
